covers.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: PianoLIT composer playlist cover, one standalone landscape image, 1584 by 960 pixels, aspect ratio 1.65:1.
Primary request: create a beautiful illustrated cover featuring the recognizable face of Florence Price. Match a cohesive collection of soft painterly piano playlist illustrations: matte gouache, watercolor washes, cut-paper-like layered silhouettes, subtle fibrous paper grain, gentle tonal shading, warm ivory accents and organic curves. The existing collection includes textured botanical leaves, imaginary arches, soft hills, calm lakes and stylized piano keys. Make this feel like another cover from that family.
Subject: a dignified illustrated bust portrait of Florence Price based on her familiar G. Nelidoff archival studio portrait: African American woman in midlife, warm medium-brown complexion, short dark waved hair parted at the side, gently rounded face, deep-set expressive eyes, composed direct gaze, small earrings, dark formal 1930s dress with a small ornamental brooch. Preserve her recognizable historical facial proportions, do not invent a generic woman. Paint her face in the SAME gouache technique as the surroundings, no photographic cutout.
Scene and design: an elegant rhythmic arrangement of magnolia-like leaves and pale blossoms, a flowing simplified keyboard along the lower edge, overlapping organic curves and one muted golden sun-disc behind the portrait; graceful spacious composition, the face is the strong focal point and occupies roughly 42 percent of the image height, head fully visible and comfortably inside edges.
Color palette: rich peacock teal, deep petrol blue, muted jade, warm gold, soft cream, natural skin tones. The visual mood is luminous, calm and confident.
Constraints: full bleed artwork; no border, no rounded corners baked into the file, no text, no lettering, no name, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no extra people, no photorealism, no caricature, no glossy 3D. This is ONE cover, not a grid.

covers.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Primary request: create a beautiful illustrated cover featuring the recognizable face of Mélanie Bonis, also known as Mel Bonis, coordinated with the Florence Price, J. S. Bach and Cécile Chaminade covers.
Style and medium: matte gouache and soft watercolor washes, gently layered cut-paper-like organic curves, delicate fibrous paper grain, softly shaded illustrated landscape. Refined dreamy storybook artwork matching PianoLIT's existing botanical, moonlit lake and piano-wave illustrations. Paint the portrait in the same gouache medium, integrated with the scenery.
Subject and likeness: Mel Bonis as a young woman based closely on Charles Corbineau's 1877 portrait, the familiar image on the official Mel Bonis association website. Fair-skinned French woman with dark brown hair swept into a high updo with a clear center part and two small curling tendrils on the forehead; large deep dark almond eyes with distinct gently arched dark eyebrows; a full oval face, rounded cheeks, a defined straight nose, small rosebud lips with a serious closed-mouth expression and softly rounded chin. Three-quarter view looking slightly to the viewer's right; small gold stud earrings and an ivory late nineteenth-century dress with a soft gauzy collar. Preserve those specific historical proportions, do not substitute a generic romantic woman or Chaminade's short fluffy curls. Head and bust, head entirely visible, face strong focal point about 42 percent of canvas height.
Scene and design: tranquil lavender twilight, a crescent moon reflected in a quiet violet lake, softly layered mauve hills and mist; a few elegant white iris flowers and slender ivy at the edges, a restrained curved ribbon of ivory and plum piano keys in the lower foreground. Open spacious background, delicate contemplative atmosphere; portrait sits toward the left with the moonlit lake beside it.
Color palette: muted lavender, smoky lilac, aubergine plum, dusty violet, silver sage, ivory, small pale moon-gold highlights and natural skin tones. This cover should be distinctly purple rather than teal, rose or ochre.
Constraints: one cover, full bleed, no grid, no border, no baked rounded corners, no names, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no UI, no extra people, no photo cutout, no caricature, no glossy 3D.

No large sun-disc, no crescent moon, no garden flowers, no architectural arches; give this cover its own nocturne-inspired visual identity.
